paper_title: Oblivious Rounding and the Integrality Gap
statement: In this work we have systematically studied the notion of oblivious rounding and its approximation guarantees, with applications to the welfare maximization problem. We mention several directions for future research. First, are there optimization problems that are not closed under convex combinations, where the best known approximation is achieved by an oblivious rounding scheme, and can potentially be improved by considering non-oblivious rounding schemes? For which problems are there polynomial-time computable oblivious rounding schemes that are comparable to the integrality gap? Finally, what else can we hope to learn about the most promising rounding techniques from properties of the combinatorial problem?
